snippet.title: Spear - New Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
🎮  SPEAR is on Steam! 🎮 

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3453000/Spear/

When a Fatal Error wipes out the hero and threatens to erase the entire game, only Default—a simple NPC armed with a spear—can save his digital world.

Dive into an action-platformer with unique mechanics, broken quests, and secrets buried in corrupted code. Who says NPCs can't be heroes?
